csharpUnityUtilities.template.description: Template for new MonoBehaviour scripts. Use {{NAMESPACE}} and {{CLASSNAME}} as placeholders.

scripts.commit-generated: git add CHANGELOG.md README.md && git commit -m "docs: auto-update"
scripts.prebuild: npm run changelog && npm run update-readme && npm run commit-generated && npm version patch
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run prebuild && npm run create-build && vsce package --out build
